purpose: Additional NIST He I persistent-line rows reserved as source-family holdouts for calibrated quantum-defect prediction diagnostics.

source.name: NIST Handbook of Basic Atomic Spectroscopic Data, Persistent Lines of Neutral Helium
source.capture_note: Rows are transcribed from the text view of the NIST He I persistent-lines table. These rows are not part of helium_many_electron_sources.json and are reserved for holdout diagnostics.

split_policy.holdout_source: Rows listed here from the same NIST source family but outside the selected calibration source package
split_policy.claim_boundary: Same-source-family holdouts are stronger than in-sample fits but weaker than independent external validation.

uncertainty_policy.source_uncertainty_status: NIST handbook row uncertainties are not explicitly captured in this package.
uncertainty_policy.rule: Use half of the last shown decimal place as a conservative transcription-rounding uncertainty for wavelength and level-energy fields.
uncertainty_policy.claim_boundary: These uncertainty fields support residual-budget diagnostics only. They are not official NIST measurement uncertainties and cannot support uncertainty-qualified helium validation.
